compact_statement: Flooding in 2018 and 2020 disrupted Faleolo International Airport; coastal transport assets face storm-surge, flood and rising-sea risk.
uncertainty: Project design and intended benefits; implementation and outcomes are not established.

statement: A West Coast Road business account recalls cyclone and wave damage to the road serving coastal businesses.
compact_statement: A West Coast Road business account recalls cyclone and wave damage to the road serving coastal businesses.
uncertainty: Implementer reporting and testimony, not an independent impact evaluation.

statement: The feature reports a completed road upgrade and improved business confidence; testimony does not establish the size or durability of resilience gains.
compact_statement: The feature reports a completed road upgrade and improved business confidence; testimony does not establish the size or durability of resilience gains.
uncertainty: Implementer reporting and testimony, not an independent impact evaluation.

statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: Rural coastal Salani had 93% of 88 households on customary land; inland suburban Vaitele had 80% of about 1,300 households on freehold land.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: Rural coastal Salani had 93% of 88 households on customary land; inland suburban Vaitele had 80% of about 1,300 households on freehold land.
uncertainty: 2016 site census, not current national shares.

statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: At Salani, 10/20 participants partly or fully linked inland moves to climate factors (four entirely); storm surge and cyclone rainfall were recurring triggers.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: At Salani, 10/20 participants partly or fully linked inland moves to climate factors (four entirely); storm surge and cyclone rainfall were recurring triggers.

source_refs.locator: Section 6(a), 'Climate responses and other mobility drivers', Salani findings.

uncertainty: Self-reported attribution within a small qualitative study; tsunami-related and socioeconomic mobility drivers are not all climate hazards.

statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: At Vaitele, 6/20 households linked movement partly or fully to climate factors; seven participants cited social reasons and seven freehold access, with overlap in environmental changes.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: At Vaitele, 6/20 households linked movement partly or fully to climate factors; seven participants cited social reasons and seven freehold access, with overlap in environmental changes.

source_refs.locator: Section 6(a), 'Climate responses and other mobility drivers', Vaitele findings.

uncertainty: Self-reported, overlapping reasons; family tensions are not characterized as violence.

statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: Seventeen of 20 Salani households near water moved inland; short moves were easier where customary access avoided land-purchase costs.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023-09-18 reports: Seventeen of 20 Salani households near water moved inland; short moves were easier where customary access avoided land-purchase costs.

source_refs.locator: Section 6(c), 'Micro-mobility patterns'; Section 7, 'fa'a-'āigalua as climate adaptation strategy'.

uncertainty: One rural village; clearing land and connecting utilities still cost time and money.

statement: Source dated 2019-10-28 reports: UNDP described Salei'a as exposed to sea-level rise, flooding, erosion, stronger tropical storms, rainfall and heat; by 2019 a revetment and raised bridge provided daily access and a disaster escape route.
compact_statement: Source dated 2019-10-28 reports: UNDP described Salei'a as exposed to sea-level rise, flooding, erosion, stronger tropical storms, rainfall and heat; by 2019 a revetment and raised bridge provided daily access and a disaster escape route.

source_refs.locator: Opening paragraphs and Salei'a mayor's statement, article dated 28 October 2019.

uncertainty: The sponsored project story reports implementation by October 2019; it is not an independent evaluation or current condition survey.

statement: Source dated 2017 reports: At Matafa'a, runoff, land management, variable rain, floods and drought were linked to poor water quality and livelihood and health effects; elderly people, women and children bore water-collection burdens.
compact_statement: Source dated 2017 reports: At Matafa'a, runoff, land management, variable rain, floods and drought were linked to poor water quality and livelihood and health effects; elderly people, women and children bore water-collection burdens.

source_refs.locator: Matafa'a, report PDF p.9, community vulnerability narrative.

uncertainty: Programme case; no population estimate or separation of climate and land-use effects.

statement: Source dated 2017 reports: The report says a mountain gravity-fed system and native reforestation were installed; Matafa'a had water during the three-month September 2011 El Niño drought, with clean water in all homes.
compact_statement: Source dated 2017 reports: The report says a mountain gravity-fed system and native reforestation were installed; Matafa'a had water during the three-month September 2011 El Niño drought, with clean water in all homes.
institutions: United Nations Development Programme Global Environment Facility Small Grants Programme

source_refs.locator: Matafa'a, report PDF p.9, adaptation outcomes narrative.

uncertainty: Project-era report of water availability during a drought described by the source as September 2011; neither climate-mode timing nor current scheme operation was independently reverified.

statement: Source dated 2017 reports: Matafa'a's community-managed scheme set a household maintenance fee; the Independent Water Scheme Association supported filter maintenance and water quality.
compact_statement: Source dated 2017 reports: Matafa'a's community-managed scheme set a household maintenance fee; the Independent Water Scheme Association supported filter maintenance and water quality.

source_refs.locator: Matafa'a, report PDF p.9, community-managed scheme and maintenance account.

uncertainty: Arrangements are reported for the project period, not verified as current.

statement: Source dated 2024-06-30 reports: Women at a Lalomanu workshop said inland relocation reduced sea access and coastal-road customers for craft and seafood businesses.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024-06-30 reports: Women at a Lalomanu workshop said inland relocation reduced sea access and coastal-road customers for craft and seafood businesses.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 'Women and (Im)Mobility in the Context of Climate Change', 'Economic Impacts and Opportunities', report p.96.

uncertainty: The cited passage does not establish whether relocation was climate-, tsunami-, or otherwise driven; no climate-attributed livelihood loss is inferred.

statement: The Pacific synthesis records Samoa participants' reports of domestic-violence concerns, but explicitly warns that sample/cultural differences may explain the Samoa–Tonga contrast.
compact_statement: The Pacific synthesis records Samoa participants' reports of domestic-violence concerns, but explicitly warns that sample/cultural differences may explain the Samoa–Tonga contrast.

source_refs.locator: Table 5, Samoa–Tonga fieldwork findings, 'Impacts' row, printed p.149.

uncertainty: No prevalence denominator, identified relocation trigger or causal climate/mobility effect. Do not generalize this qualitative signal to Samoa as a whole.

statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: In June 2025, PREPARE planned six years of hazard monitoring, early warning, response and urban resilience work, with township planning focused on Sālelologa.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: In June 2025, PREPARE planned six years of hazard monitoring, early warning, response and urban resilience work, with township planning focused on Sālelologa.
institutions: Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure
Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment

source_refs.locator: Executive Summary, printed pp.1–2; Project Description, printed pp.6–7.

uncertainty: June 2025 project design; delivery not confirmed.

statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: The ESMF identifies Sālelologa land disputes as a potential planning conflict risk; proposed controls map disputes, exclude disputed areas and use consultation and grievance handling.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: The ESMF identifies Sālelologa land disputes as a potential planning conflict risk; proposed controls map disputes, exclude disputed areas and use consultation and grievance handling.
institutions: Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure

source_refs.locator: Section 5.3.2, preliminary Sālelologa social risks, printed p.40; risk analysis table, printed p.53.

uncertainty: Preliminary Sālelologa planning safeguard risk around unresolved land disputes, not observed project-induced conflict or a climate-caused incident.

statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: The ESMF flags possible exclusion of women, youth, people with disabilities and other marginalized groups from Sālelologa planning.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: The ESMF flags possible exclusion of women, youth, people with disabilities and other marginalized groups from Sālelologa planning.

source_refs.locator: Section 5.3.2, preliminary Sālelologa social risks, printed p.40.

uncertainty: Preparation-stage exclusion risk, not proof exclusion occurred or safeguards were delivered.
